comment: src/DMAFX.cpp at commit b90cd69, with the expander protocol in src/DMA.hpp. The host is taken from rightExpander (DMA.hpp line 267), so this module sits to the LEFT of the one it works on, which is the opposite of the usual Rack convention and is the single thing most likely to make it look broken. It has no outputs at all. Rotation is a transpose followed by a mirror (lines 208-251) and is skipped unless the memory is square; the two lamps report that. Randomise on a memory of true and false values compares a fresh random number spread over -10 to 10 against the minimum trimpot alone, so that trimpot becomes the chance of a cell coming out on and the maximum trimpot has no effect there. The invert switch is likewise ignored for such a memory, which is simply flipped. The panel prints DMA-FX, Channels with the found count beside it, Scroll over the eight direction jacks, Flip/Rotate with a 90 degree arrow pair, and Misc. Ops over the invert and randomise rows.
